Tested /trust, /policies index, all 12 /policies/:slug detail pages, redirects (/terms, /tos -> /policies/terms), unknown-slug fallback, legacy /policy, footer links, and Trust Center search (grouped results + empty state + section jump-links). PolicyDetailPage.jsx wraps section.intro and section.outro (which are already ReactElements containing

) in an outer
